property_summary: For any calldata carrying an immutable-args block, c.owner() must return the 20-byte address stored at immutable-arg offset 0x0; the mutant reads offset 0x28 (past the block), yielding address(0) for any nonzero address, breaking the rule.

For any admissible immutable-args payload appended to the calldata, C.owner() must return the address stored at arg offset 0x0; the mutant reads offset 0x3c instead, so it returns a different (e.g. zero) address and violates the rule.

On any clone created by CoolerFactory, collateral() must return the collateral token passed to generateCooler (immutable arg at 0x14), not the owner (arg at 0x0); the mutant returns the owner, so for any fuzzed (owner, token) pair with owner != token the rule c.collateral() == token breaks.

For any cooler clone created by the factory, its collateral token (immutable arg at offset 0x14) must be a value distinct from its owner (immutable arg at offset 0x0) whenever owner != token; the mutant reads offset 0x0 for collateral(), making collateral() equal owner() and breaking the rule.

For any cooler clone generated by the factory, its public collateral() getter must return the collateral token address embedded as the immutable arg at offset 0x14 (i.e. the token actually passed to generateCooler), which holds for every admissible input in the reference; the mutant reads the owner arg at offset 0x0 instead, so for any fuzzed (owner, token) pair with owner != token the clone returns the owner address and the rule is broken.

For any fuzzed (owner, token) pair with owner != token, C.collateral() must read the packed immutable arg at offset 0x14 and return the token address, not the owner at 0x0; the mutant returns the owner, breaking the rule.

For every clone the factory creates from fuzzed token parameters, c.collateral() must return the collateral token address embedded at immutable-arg offset 0x14 (the value passed to generateCooler); the mutant reads offset 0x0 and instead returns the owner, so for any fuzzed collateral token different from the caller the rule is broken.

For any collateral/debt token pair, a cooler generated by CoolerFactory must return exactly the supplied collateral token from its public collateral() getter; the mutant instead returns the factory address at immutable-arg offset 0x3c, breaking this for (almost) every fuzzed pair.
